Oracle Fusion HCM 27A: Redwood defaults announced so far

Oracle hasn't published its 27A What's New documents yet, but its 26C and 26D documents already announce several HCM changes for 27A. Here is everything we've found, with the profile option codes Oracle gives and a link to each Oracle page. We add new 27A announcements as Oracle publishes them.

Checked against Oracle's pages on 2026-10-19. Oracle can revise its What's New pages; always confirm on the linked Oracle page.

Employment pages: Redwood by default in 27A (3)

Each page has its own profile option, and you can set it back to No to keep the older page. Per Oracle, the Redwood Mass Assignment Change page itself arrives in 26D.

PageProfile option codeRedwood page first delivered
Resign From EmploymentORA_PER_EMPL_RESIGNATION_REDWOOD_ENABLED24C
Mass Assignment ChangeORA_PER_EMPL_MASS_ASG_UPDATE_REDWOOD_ENABLED26D
Terminate EmploymentORA_PER_EMPL_TERMINATE_REDWOOD_ENABLED24C

Oracle sources: Oracle 26D What's New: Redwood Enabled by Default for Employment Pages in Update 27A · Oracle 26C What's New: Redwood Enabled by Default for Employment Pages in Update 27A

Positions pages and guided processes: Redwood by default in 27A

The Positions pages and the Request a New Position and Request a Position Change guided processes switch together: Oracle says the one profile option ORA_PER_POSITIONS_REDWOOD_ENABLED covers all of them. Setting it to No keeps the older pages.

PageProfile option codeRedwood page first delivered
Positions pagesORA_PER_POSITIONS_REDWOOD_ENABLED23B
Request a New Position (guided process)ORA_PER_POSITIONS_REDWOOD_ENABLED24A
Request a Position Change (guided process)ORA_PER_POSITIONS_REDWOOD_ENABLED24A

Oracle sources: Oracle 26D What's New: Redwood Enabled by Default for Positions Pages and Guided Processes in Update 27A

Payroll: only the Redwood calculation cards supported from 27A (2)

Learning: responsive Career Development pages

Responsive Career Development pages no longer supported

LearningMigrationFrom 26DRevert: None stated: automatic move to Redwood in 27A

Responsive Career Development pages are no longer supported after 26D; anyone still on them moves to Redwood automatically in 27A.

Pages affected: Me > Career > Career Development, My Team > Career Overview > Performance

Oracle's title: “Mandatory migration to Redwood Career Development”

Oracle source

Other HCM changes Oracle has announced for 27A (2)

Apply with Indeed discontinued

RecruitingRemovalFrom 27ARevert: None stated: Oracle points to Direct Apply with Indeed (since 25D)

Apply with Indeed is phased out from 27A; Oracle points to Direct Apply with Indeed, available since 25D.

Pages affected: Apply with Indeed on Oracle career sites

Oracle source

Learning BI Cloud Connector extracts replaced

LearningEnd of supportFrom 27ARevert: None stated

Learning BICC is no longer supported from 27A; Oracle replaces it with Learning Catalog and Assignments Data Extraction (26C).

Pages affected: Learning BI Cloud Connector (BICC)

Oracle source

Looking further: 27B

Legacy person navigation disabled by default

From 27B

From 27B, the non-Redwood navigation (tiles, quick actions and navigator entries) to the responsive and classic person pages is off by default: My Client Groups, Person Management, Person Spotlight, Me, Directory, My Public Info and My Organization Chart. Oracle says you can still reach them by setting the relevant profile option to No, and that the list of profile options will come in the 27B What's New.

Oracle source

Classic job search decommissioned; Smart Search on by default

RecruitingRemovalFrom 27BRevert: None stated

Classic search stays enabled by default for now; in 27B Oracle decommissions classic search and enables Smart Search by default for all customers. If you switch earlier and use custom pages, publish the site, then review and republish the new page drafts.

Pages affected: Career site job search

Oracle's title: “Smart Search Enhancements”

Oracle source
